description: What story the market is currently telling itself, read from keyless news feeds (Federal Reserve, SEC, WSJ, CNBC, Yahoo) and cross-checked against the macro tape. Returns ranked themes with their share of coverage, dated and linked sample headlines, and for each theme the actual market series that would corroborate it. Headline counts measure ATTENTION, never truth: where a theme leads coverage and its series has not moved, that divergence is the finding. Every item must carry a timestamp inside the window or it is reported as excluded. Themes come from a fixed lexicon, so a genuinely new narrative lands in unclassified_headlines rather than being discovered, and the output says so.

as_of.description: ISO date treated as now. Defaults to today.

days.description: Recency window in days. Defaults to 7.

extra_queries.description: Up to 4 extra Google News queries to fold in, e.g. a sector or a country.

top.description: How many themes to return. Defaults to 6.

name: get_market_narrative
title: Summarize Market Narratives
